chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Khālid, from ʿUthmān ibn ʿĪsā, from Samāʿah ibn Mihrān, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The woman is buried up to her waist, then the Imam casts, then the people cast with small stones.

key_terms.أَحْجَارٍ: stones used in carrying out the punishment
key_terms.الْإِمَامُ: the Imam who initiates the legal procedure
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman subject to the ruling
key_terms.تُدْفَنُ: is buried or placed into the ground

ai.seo_question: How is the punishment of stoning for a woman described in Tahdhib al-Ahkam?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the manner in which a woman is positioned and how the punishment is initiated and carried out. It indicates that the Imam begins the act, after which the people proceed, using small stones.
